_comment: MANUAL HOLD list for the ДС facet. The affiliations themselves are not hand-curated: scripts/person/resolve_persons.ts attaches an MP from ds_announcement (migration 203, the Commission's own decision documents, db:load:ds:pg) only on an exact folded-name AND birth-date match that names exactly one MP. A name listed here is NEVER attached, however that join resolves, until a human removes it. Empty since 2026-11-22: the three earlier holds (Каракачанов, Местан, Адил) came from the Wikisource transcription of decision № 14, whose birth dates did not match; the Commission's own documents print dates that DO match each MP, and the owner released them.
